question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Serene
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Serene"** means calm, peaceful, and untroubled. (शांत)

 
 
• **Example:** The lake was serene in the early morning, with no ripples disturbing its surface.
 
 
 
• **"Calm"** refers to a state of being free from agitation, excitement, or disturbance. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example:** She remained calm during the emergency, which helped everyone else stay composed.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Chaotic** (अराजक): Completely disordered or confused.

 
 
• **Example:** The office was chaotic after the announcement of the merger.
 
 
 
• **Agitated** (उत्तेजित): Feeling or appearing troubled or nervous.
 
 
• **Example:** She was visibly agitated after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• **Angry** (गुस्से में): Feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.
 
 
• **Example:** He was angry when he found out someone had scratched his car.
